text: Make an 8-second vertical testimonial-style ad for FitTrack. A fictional woman in her 30s, filming herself at home, talks to camera: “FitTrack makes planning my workouts so easy. I finally have a routine that sticks.” Keep it friendly and casual, with matching captions. Use a made-up presenter, not a real customer. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?
